items.note: faces south (-Y) into the room. Plan draws it on the WEST party wall facing east; modelled on the NORTH wall facing south to keep the materializer's axis-aligned rotation convention (rot 90/270 swaps w/d about the centre and would push a west-wall 2100mm sofa out of bounds). DEPTH d=860 (was 600) — FF&E round-2 reconciliation (2026-07-04): the drawn 600mm shallow depth is unbuyable (no armed Thai 3-seater is <745mm; selected Index Lamona FFE-S01 = 860 deep). Back kept flush to the north-wall inner face (y_back=3200), front now y=2340. Height h=800 retained by specifying a low-leg variant (real product is 920; FF&E note 'trim with lower legs'). Coffee table nudged 150mm south to preserve sofa-front legroom (~340mm). Re-gated 2026-07-04: clearance PASS, function PASS. The conversation group (sofa + round coffee table + 2 armchairs + west console) is preserved.
